title: Automate Inventory Management System Testing
desc:
Develop automated test case to test the workflow of an inventory & material management system. The system is a webapplication. 

The Test Scenario as a summary is
A Property has a warehouse where spare part inventory is stored. Maintenance requests consume the inventory in the Property warehouse. 
A material request scans the warehouse for spare parts which are under the reorder level and prepares the list of spare parts and the min qty that needs to be ordered.
The ordering process is outside the system. The spare parts once received are updated in the central warehouse inventory.
The material fulfillment team then updates the Material Request list with the received materials. The inventory in the central warehouse is reduced. When the spare parts in the Material request list is delivered at the warehouse in the property the inventory there is increased.

Different scenarios have to be chalked out, data created and automated test script created to run the test cases.

I need a polished, eye-catching “Save the Date” graphic that I can share directly through WhatsApp. I’ve decided to go fully digital, so the layout has to look great on mobile screens, load quickly, and remain clear when forwarded or placed in a WhatsApp Status.  

Here’s what I’m after:  
• A single square or portrait-oriented image, optimised for WhatsApp’s recommended dimensions and file size limits.  
• Colour palette, fonts and overall style that feel modern and elegant, while leaving room for me to add final event details if plans shift slightly.  
• Delivery of both a high-resolution master file (PSD or AI) and a compressed JPEG/PNG that is under WhatsApp’s 100 KB guideline without noticeable quality loss.  

Acceptance criteria  
• Text is legible on a standard phone screen without zooming.  
• No pixelation or artefacts after compression.  
• Final file passes a quick WhatsApp send test without triggering additional compression.  

If you’ve created social-media-ready invitations before, especially for WhatsApp, I’d love to see a sample or two and get this wrapped up quickly.

title: Exciting Corporate Brand Video Production
desc:
I need a seasoned video producer to craft a live-action corporate promo that instantly boosts brand awareness and leaves viewers energised about who we are and what we do. Think sleek cinematography, dynamic camera movement, punchy editing, and a soundtrack that drives momentum from the first frame to the last.

Here’s the journey I’m picturing:
• Pre-production: refine a concise concept, storyboard, and script that communicates our core message in roughly 5-7 minutes.  
• Production: multi day location shoot (office and light on-site b-roll) with professional lighting, audio and at least two camera angles to keep the pace engaging.  
• Post: fast-cut editing, color grading, motion-tracked titles or subtle lower-thirds, licensed music, and final mastering in both 16:9 and vertical social formats (1080p).

I’ll supply brand guidelines, key talking points, and access to team members for short on-camera sound bites; you bring the gear, crew, creative direction, and the spark that turns everyday footage into a vibrant brand story.

Final deliverables:
 • Master video (5-7 minutes) in MP4 H.264  
• Social cut-downs (30 secs)  
• Clean version with music  
• All project files (Premiere/Resolve + assets)

Please share a link to at least two past live-action promos that capture an exciting, dynamic feel. If our styles align, we can lock dates and move straight into pre-production.

title: Urgent Product Close-Up Photos
desc:
I’m looking for crisp, high-resolution close-up shots that capture the fine details of my products for use on e-commerce listings. Speed matters—I’d like the finished, fully edited images delivered as soon as possible after we agree on the brief.

Here’s what I have in mind: each product should be photographed from several angles, with tight framing that highlights texture, craftsmanship, and any distinguishing features buyers need to see before clicking “add to cart.” Clean, consistent lighting is essential; subtle depth-of-field is welcome so long as the focal points remain tack-sharp. I’ll need both web-ready JPEGs (sRGB, under 500 KB) and full-resolution masters suitable for future cropping or print work.

You can let me know whether you prefer that I ship the items to your studio or schedule an on-site session—I’m flexible as long as the turnaround stays fast. Basic retouching (color balance, dust removal, minor blemish cleanup) should be included, and filenames must follow a simple SKU-based convention so I can drop them straight into my store.

Deliverables
• 5–7 close-up/detail images per product (final count to be confirmed)
• High-res files (minimum 3000 px on the shortest edge)
• Optimized web versions
• All rights transferred upon final payment

If you already have a macro lens, a controlled lighting setup, and a streamlined post-processing workflow, I’d love to see a sample of similar work and hear how quickly you can turn this around.

title: Pre-Employment Vetting Project, Guatemala city – Guatemala
desc:
I need a reliable partner in Guatemala City who can confirm that the health-care professionals we are about to hire truly hold valid national licenses. Your task is straightforward: contact the appropriate licensing body, verify the licence status, and provide me a brief written report with evidence (for example, a registry screenshot or formal confirmation) so I can attach it to each candidate’s file.

Key points you will cover:  
• Verify the licence is genuine, current, and issued by the correct authority.  
• Capture the licence number, holder’s name, issue and expiry dates, plus the verification method you used.  
• Supply any official reference (web link, stamped document, or email confirmation) that supports your finding.

Send the final report in PDF or Word; no style requirements, just clarity and verifiable facts. Turnaround within two business days of receiving each candidate’s data would be ideal.

title: Beginner Non-Verbal Reasoning Bank
desc:
I’m building a fresh pool of qualitative aptitude material that focuses exclusively on beginner-friendly non-verbal reasoning. The goal is to have clear, well-graded items that help newcomers recognise patterns, shapes and spatial relationships without feeling overwhelmed.  

Here’s what I need from you:  
• Original non-verbal reasoning questions at a true beginner level  
• An answer key with concise, step-by-step explanations for each item  
• Delivery in an editable format (Google Sheets, Excel or Word is fine) so I can slot them straight into my learning modules  

There’s no fixed deadline, so take the time you need to ensure each question is accurate, unambiguous and free of copyright issues. We can agree on batch sizes and review checkpoints once we start. If you’ve created similar content before, feel free to mention it; otherwise, simply show me a short sample so I can confirm the style and difficulty match what I’m after.

title: Humorous Footwear Copywriting Needed
desc:
I’m refreshing my footwear e-commerce site and need punchy, sales-driven copy that turns browsers into buyers. Every word on the site should build a clear, memorable brand personality—think witty, down-to-earth humour that makes shoppers smile while guiding them straight to “Add to Cart.”

Scope of work  
• Home page hero lines, taglines and section blurbs  
• Category intros that set the tone for each shoe range  
• 18 product descriptions (approx. 120–150 words each) with benefit-led, SEO-friendly phrasing  
• A playful About-Us story plus concise FAQ, Shipping and Returns copy

Acceptance criteria  
• Tone stays consistently light, clever and conversational without losing professionalism  
• Each piece nudges the reader toward purchase with clear calls to action  
• Keywords supplied by me are woven in naturally for on-page SEO  
• Final copy delivered in Google Docs, ready for quick paste into Shopify

If you have a knack for selling style through storytelling and can keep humour on-brand rather than cheesy, I’d love to see samples of similar e-commerce work and learn how soon you can start.

title: E-commerce Account Management Partner
desc:
I run a young but fast-growing agency that manages seller accounts across Amazon, Flipkart, Meesho and Myntra. The workload has reached the point where I now want a genuine partner rather than just another contractor. You should already understand the e-commerce ecosystem end-to-end so we can divide responsibilities, make decisions together and scale the portfolio without missing a beat.

Day-to-day you will touch every aspect of account health on Amazon and our other marketplaces: inventory tracking, catalogue creation, keyword-rich listing optimisation, Sponsored Ads and PPC, customer messages, and continuous performance reporting through Seller Central and platform analytics. I will keep bringing in new clients; you will help service them, shape strategy, and share in the growth.

Deliverables we will own together
• Fully optimised product listings for each new SKU, uploaded error-free  
• Inventory levels monitored daily with proactive restock recommendations  
• PPC campaigns built, tuned and reported on weekly for ROAS targets  
• Monthly performance dashboards covering sales, fees, ratings and compliance alerts  

If you are comfortable living inside Seller Central, Flipkart Seller Hub, Meesho Supplier Panel or Myntra Partner Portal, use tools such as Excel bulk sheets, Helium 10, or similar, and you are excited by the idea of long-term collaboration, let us talk about next steps and how we can split responsibilities, milestones and rewards.

title: Urdu-English QA Reviewer Needed
desc:
I am assembling a small team to quality-check Urdu-to-English content. You will read the original Urdu, compare it with its English counterpart, and flag or fix any mistranslations, style issues, or inconsistencies.  

Because my own English is only at a basic level while my Urdu is advanced, I rely on you to shape the final English so it reads naturally to a native or near-native audience. Clear, concise feedback in English is essential, and you should feel comfortable explaining why a change is required.

Typical files arrive in Word, Excel, or occasionally CAT-tool exports; you may use the tools you prefer, provided the final package is easy for me to follow. Turnaround is usually within 24-48 hours, though larger batches come with more lead time.

To be considered, send your updated résumé or CV and a brief note highlighting relevant QA or linguistic experience. If you have sample corrections, even better—attach them so I can see your eye for detail. Feel free to DM me if you need more information.

title: Stealth Windows Remote Access Software
desc:
I need a custom-built solution that lets me reach any company-owned Windows laptop or desktop—even when the machine is off-site on a home or public network—and view or take control of the screen without the user seeing a tray icon, task-bar entry, pop-up, or other visual cue. The session must establish through the computer’s hostname rather than its IP, so reliable name resolution across networks is essential.

Key workflow  
• A small, silent agent runs at startup, phones home to a secure relay, and registers the machine under its hostname.  
• From an admin console I choose the hostname, click Connect, and the agent launches a full-quality remote desktop session where I can interact with mouse and keyboard.  
• No file-transfer panel, activity logging, or session recording is necessary—only live viewing and remote control.  
• All traffic travels over an encrypted channel so it passes firewalls/NAT without manual port forwarding.

Deliverables  
• Installer/auto-update agent for Windows 10 & 11  
• Admin console (desktop or web) with hostname list, connect/disconnect buttons, basic authentication, and TLS encryption  
• Source code with build instructions and brief deployment guide  
• Proof-of-concept test demonstrating an uninterrupted, notification-free connection on two separate networks

Acceptance criteria

title: Survey Trend Analysis Specialist Needed
desc:
I have a raw survey dataset that is ready for deeper exploration. My primary interest is to uncover and clearly present the trends hiding in the responses so that I can turn those insights into actionable decisions.  

You will receive the full spreadsheet (exported from Google Forms) along with a brief about the respondent profile. Your job is to clean the data, run the appropriate statistical tests, and translate the numbers into a concise narrative supported by easy-to-read charts. Python (pandas, seaborn, matplotlib), R, or SPSS are all fine—as long as the method is transparent and reproducible.  

Deliverables I expect:  
• A short, well-structured report that highlights the key trends you discover, written in plain language.  
• At least three clear visualizations (bar, line, or heat map—pick what shows the story best).  
• The cleaned dataset plus any scripts or notebooks so I can rerun the analysis later.  

When you respond, point me to past work where you tackled similar survey analyses. That will help me see how you communicate findings and present visuals. Looking forward to spotting the patterns together.

desc:

Here’s what the work will involve:  
• Story development and script polish in collaboration with me  
• All 3D production steps—modelling, texturing, rigging, animation, lighting and rendering  
• Voice-over and sound design that complement the adult tone  
• Final delivery of a mastered video file ready for online release, plus editable project files for future tweaks

Blender, Maya, Cinema 4D, Houdini or similar pipelines are welcome as long as the final result is smooth, polished and broadcast-quality. Please share examples of completed 3D cartoons or comparable entertainment pieces featuring nuanced character animation and expressive storytelling. I’ll review reels, discuss timelines and milestones, and then we can lock in the creative direction together.
